items.headline_en: Mika: On-Device AI Agent for Android
items.summary_en: Mika is an on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to complete tasks for users. It lets users hand app and web actions to an agent instead of handling each step manually; the GitHub repository gained 9,160 stars in 21 days.
items.headline_zh: Mika：Android 裝置端 AI 代理
items.summary_zh: Mika（Android 裝置端 AI 代理）可操作手機應用及網頁，完成指定事項；過往要逐項點擊，現可交由代理處理。GitHub 專案 21 日獲 9,160 星。一般 Android 自動化可比較 Tasker。

items.headline_en: AI Team Chat
items.summary_en: Agentes Chat is an open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where teams and AI agents collaborate in channels and direct messages. Instead of switching between team chat and separate AI tools, users can run Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, or Grok agents with MCP tools, browser and computer control, routines, memory, approvals, and web, desktop, and phone apps in one workspace.
items.headline_zh: Agentes Chat 自架 AI 協作平台
items.summary_zh: Agentes Chat（開源、自架的 Slack 替代品）讓團隊與 AI 代理在頻道及私訊協作，代理可運行於 Claude、ChatGPT/Codex、Gemini 或 Grok，並具 MCP 工具、瀏覽器與電腦操作、例程、記憶和審批。用戶毋須在團隊聊天與個別 AI 工具間切換，現可把人與 AI 工作集中在同一自架空間，並使用網頁、桌面和手機程式。同類選擇可看 Mattermost。

items.headline_en: STE80 Humanizer Moves AI Text 80% Toward STE100
items.summary_en: STE80 Humanizer is a GitHub agent skill that removes common signs of AI writing and rewrites text 80% of the way toward ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, a method Andrej Karpathy shared. It lets users turn AI-assisted drafts into clearer technical writing instead of editing every line by hand; the repository gained 960 GitHub stars in 10 days, and Grammarly is a similar general writing option.

items.headline_en: Inferssd Runs Large AI Models From SSD
items.summary_en: Inferssd is a llama.cpp-based tool that streams Mixture-of-Experts model experts from SSD, allowing models larger than available RAM or VRAM to run. Users can run larger AI models on memory-constrained computers without first upgrading their memory.
items.headline_zh: Inferssd 從 SSD 運行大型 AI 模型

items.headline_en: Turbo Browser MCP Streamlines Playwright Automation
items.summary_en: Turbo Browser MCP is a Playwright MCP server offering one-call form filling, delta snapshots, batched steps, and a submit guard enabled by default; it gained 132 GitHub stars in five days. By reducing browser-agent turns and token use versus step-by-step control, it simplifies automation, while Microsoft Playwright MCP is another option.
items.headline_zh: Turbo Browser MCP 精簡自動化

items.headline_en: Inside LLM Compares Quantized GGUF Models
items.summary_en: Inside LLM is a browser-based tool that reveals where two GGUF quantizations diverge token by token and shows how different samplers affect outputs. Users can compare model behavior directly instead of manually checking results from separate runs.

items.summary_zh: Inside LLM 是一個瀏覽器模型比較工具，可逐 token 比較兩個 GGUF 量化模型的分歧，並查看不同採樣器如何影響輸出。用戶毋須逐個載入模型再肉眼對照，現在亦可用 LM Studio 或 llama.cpp。

items.headline_en: v0.40.17-rc2: mlxrunner: adapt saved history to memory pressure (#19678)
items.summary_en: mlxrunner: adapt saved history to memory pressure Retain Metal prefix history using observed memory headroom and execution workspace rather than a fixed 8 GiB allowance. Release unused buffers and cold history when system compression grows, preserving reusable paths and active requests. Cover pressure reclamation, snapshot ownership, memory observation, and cacheless request isolation. address comments address comments

model : hrm : do not compute slot count as uint32_t ( #32601 ) load_arch_hparams multiplies n_hrm_layers_per_stack, n_hrm_h_cycles and (n_hrm_l_cycles + 1) into a uint32_t, then asserts the product equals block_count. Any factors whose true product is block_count + k*2^32 still pass the assert; 1073741825 * 2 * 2 = 2^32 + 4 compares equal to block_count = 4. load_arch_tensors iterates the same three values in int and writes past the end of the block_count-sized layers vector. Website: https://ll
Release 0.171.0

items.headline_en: Inside Amazon Connect Talent: The science of structured AI interviews
